tools.name: crm-intelligence_contact-normalize
tools.description: Normalize names, emails, phone numbers, company names, and addresses from a CSV or JSON contact export. Original values stay beside the normalized values. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/crm-intelligence/contact-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: crm-intelligence_company-normalize
tools.description: Normalize company names, domains, phone numbers, and addresses from a CSV or JSON company export. A trailing legal suffix stays in the name and is used only as a match key. tools.name: crm-intelligence_duplicate-company-detect
tools.description: Find duplicate companies by a normalized domain or company-name key, and flag fuzzy name matches with a confidence level. Different domains are not merged. Suggestions do not change a CRM. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/crm-intelligence/duplicate-company-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payme

tools.name: crm-intelligence_record-enrichment-from-input
tools.description: Copy caller-supplied facts into empty contact fields. A fact never overwrites a value that is already present, and no contact detail is invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/crm-intelligence/record-enrichment-from-input. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: crm-intelligence_data-quality-audit
tools.description: Report missing names, invalid emails, short phone numbers, missing companies, and duplicate records. A company is not inferred from an email domain. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/crm-intelligence/data-quality-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: crm-intelligence_contact-relationship-match
tools.description: Link each contact to a company that was supplied in the same request, by company-name key or email domain. A company that was not supplied is not created. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/crm-intelligence/contact-relationship-match. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: crm-intelligence_database-cleanup-report
tools.description: Combine normalized records, duplicate pairs, safe merge suggestions, caller-fact enrichment, relationship matches, and quality issues. No external CRM is changed. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/crm-intelligence/database-cleanup-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.
